content.short: AlphaPing runs mandate-driven, non-custodial onchain credit vaults with defined risk boundaries.
content.description: AlphaPing operates non-custodial credit vaults on Hyperliquid, each governed by an explicit mandate whose risk constraints are enforced in the contract. The range includes Alpha USDC Core V2, a conservative over-collateralized mandate with deterministic liquidity rules, and Alpha USDC Enhanced V2 for higher-yield exposure. A LINK-denominated vault provides structured credit exposure inside the Chainlink ecosystem, and vault accounting stays visible, so an allocator can check positions against the stated mandate at any point.
content.meta: Onchain credit vaults on Hyperliquid operating under explicit, verifiable investment mandates.
